best_params.rationale: Catches 10/11 labeled-bad episodes (the miss, Sage day7 06:13, improved both needs ~650pts and is better classified healthy); zero detections on never-thrashing agents Ash and Hazel; 19 total detection-episodes over 6.2 game-days concentrated in the real day-4/5 storms; the clause removes all ~1251 healthy-interleave raw firings at this cell.

detections_per_agent.comment: merged detection-episodes at W=4h,K=8 with need clause (raw in parentheses)

false_positive_notes: Without the need clause the detector is unusable: 827 (W2K8) to 2736 (W8K3) raw firing-points per sweep cell occur in windows where both needs are >=500 AND at least one is improving (textbook healthy interleaving, e.g. Rowan day4: 47 flips but food +725 and warmth +902); the clause removes 100% of these by construction.

Flip volume alone is not pathology: several 100+ flip dawn-to-dusk days end with both needs far higher (Oak day4: +723 food, +902 warmth). The genuinely bad episodes are the flat/negative-need ones: Sage day5 (152 flips, food -56 over 15.6h), Sage day6 20:50 (25.7 flips/h, zero gain, 134 tiles/need-point), Fern day6 11:59 (+12 food for 773 tiles, 59.5 tiles/need-point), Cedar day5 13:02 (44 flips, food -365).
Thrash was village-wide on days 4-5 (Birch/Cedar/Rowan too, not just Sage/Fern/Oak) and daytime (06:00-22:00); per-agent alerts should aggregate to one village-level event.

Oak's exposure death (day7 04:04) was NOT oscillation: final ~6h emitted only chop(reflex)/wander(planner) intents while warmth drained 636->0; an oscillation detector cannot catch death-by-neglect — needs a separate 'critical need with zero intents in its class for T' detector.
Needs-capped edge case: the clause reads 'no improvement' as bad, so flipping with both needs pinned at 1000 would fire; guard with 'at least one need < cap - eps at window end'.
Switch-rate (all-class changes/game-hour) is a weak discriminator: healthy Hazel scores 8.63/h, above dead Oak's 8.31, because seek/wander churn dominates.

provenance.tick_base: 1 tick = 1 game-second; tick 0 = day1 06:00; 16h days, 8h nights
provenance.need_signal: agent.needs_changed every 60 ticks per agent, 0-1000 scale
